crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.18 18. TAIDA pada Public Communication
Baseball Model tetap dapat digunakan:

TARGET → ATTENTION → INTEREST → DESIRE → ACTION

Tetapi:

jangan menyamakan TAIDA dengan algoritma untuk memanipulasi public.

TAIDA membantu kita memahami:

communication state.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.19 19. TARGET
Dalam public communication:

siapa persons yang secara reasonable perlu mendengar message ini?

Contoh:
Bukan:

“Semua orang.”

Lebih baik:

“Mahasiswa tahun pertama yang baru mulai menggunakan generative AI untuk belajar.”

Target lebih jelas.
Language dapat lebih relevant.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.20 20. ATTENTION
Public mengatakan:

“Ini relevan bagi saya.”

Contoh:

“Menggunakan AI dapat mempercepat belajar, tetapi juga dapat membuat kita merasa memahami sesuatu yang sebenarnya belum kita pahami.”

Student:

“Itu saya.”

Attention diperoleh melalui:

relevance.

Bukan hanya:

shock.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.21 21. INTEREST
Public bertanya:

“Bagaimana cara menggunakannya dengan lebih baik?”

Sekarang kita dapat menawarkan:

method atau idea.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.22 22. DESIRE
Person melihat desired future:

“Saya ingin menggunakan AI tetapi tetap benar-benar belajar.”
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.23 23. ACTION
Call to action:

“Pada tugas berikut, jawab soal sendiri terlebih dahulu, kemudian gunakan AI untuk mengkritik jawaban Anda.”

Action:

specific.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.24 24. Responsible Public TAIDA
Maka progression-nya:

RELEVANT PERSON ↓ RELEVANT ISSUE ↓ USEFUL POSSIBILITY ↓ CREDIBLE VALUE ↓ VOLUNTARY ACTION

Bukan:

clickbait → fear → pressure → conversion.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.25 25. Public Narrative
Public communication sering membutuhkan:

narrative.

Narrative sederhana mempunyai:

16.25.1 PERSON
Siapa yang mengalami?


16.25.2 SITUATION
Apa yang terjadi?


16.25.3 PROBLEM / OPPORTUNITY
Apa yang penting?


16.25.4 POSSIBILITY
Apa yang dapat dilakukan?


16.25.5 CONSEQUENCE
Apa yang dapat berubah?
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.26 26. Example
Buruk:

“Kami membuat AI learning analytics platform berbasis LLM.”

Lebih narrative:

“Mahasiswa sekarang dapat memperoleh jawaban AI dalam hitungan detik, tetapi jawaban cepat belum tentu menghasilkan understanding. Kami sedang mencoba pendekatan di mana AI tidak langsung memberi jawaban, tetapi membantu mahasiswa menemukan bagian reasoning yang lemah.”

Sekarang ada:

person,
problem,
tension,
possibility.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.27 27. Story Membawa Meaning
Data:

“40% mahasiswa menggunakan AI setiap hari.”

Story:

“Seorang mahasiswa dapat menyelesaikan homework dengan AI dalam 10 menit, tetapi ketika ditanya menjelaskan jawabannya di kelas ia tidak mampu.”

Story membuat:

problem visible.

Tetapi story harus:

truthful dan appropriately represented.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.28 28. Jangan Membuat Fiction sebagai Evidence
Jika story hypothetical:

katakan hypothetical.

Jika composite:

jelaskan bila relevan.

Jika actual person:

pertimbangkan privacy.

Public narrative tidak boleh mengorbankan:

dignity person

demi:

dramatic communication.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.29 29. Public Language
Public language sebaiknya:

understandable,
concise,
relevant,
concrete,
respectful.

Hindari unnecessary jargon.
Misalnya:
Technical:

“The model suffers from hallucination under retrieval failure.”

Public:

“Ketika AI tidak menemukan informasi yang cukup, ia masih dapat menghasilkan jawaban yang terdengar meyakinkan tetapi salah.”

Meaning:

dipertahankan.

Language:

diterjemahkan.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.30 30. Simplification ≠ Distortion
Kita perlu menyederhanakan.
Tetapi tidak boleh:

mengubah truth.

Contoh buruk:

“AI selalu berbohong.”

Lebih tepat:

“AI dapat menghasilkan jawaban salah dengan bahasa yang terdengar meyakinkan.”

Simple.
Tetapi lebih accurate.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.31 31. Layered Public Communication
Good public communication dapat mempunyai beberapa layers.

16.31.1 Headline

satu idea utama.



16.31.2 Summary

3–5 sentences.



16.31.3 Explanation

lebih lengkap.



16.31.4 Evidence

data/source.



16.31.5 Technical Detail

untuk yang ingin deeper.

Ini memungkinkan different persons memilih:

level sesuai kebutuhan.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.32 32. One Message, Multiple Repertoires
Satu meaning dapat dikomunikasikan melalui:

article,
presentation,
infographic,
video,
podcast,
story,
demonstration,
simulation,
interactive tool.

Repertoire dipilih berdasarkan:

objective dan person.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.33 33. Medium Changes Communication
Satu message pada:

academic paper

berbeda dengan:

TikTok video.

Bukan hanya panjang.
Medium mengubah:

tempo,
attention window,
context,
interaction,
permanence,
sharing behavior.

Communicator harus memahami:

medium is part of the communication system.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.34 34. Public Communication Mempunyai Context Collapse
Di private conversation:

kita tahu siapa receiver.

Di public media:
post yang ditujukan kepada:

mahasiswa IT

mungkin dibaca oleh:

parent,
journalist,
manager,
stranger.

Ini disebut secara praktis:

context collapse.

Message dapat keluar dari intended audience.
Maka public communicator perlu bertanya:

How might this message be interpreted outside my intended context?
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.35 35. Screenshot Test
Sebelum public posting, tanyakan:

“Kalau satu sentence ini di-screenshot tanpa paragraph lain, apakah meaning-nya menjadi sangat misleading?”

Tidak selalu bisa dicegah.
Tetapi communicator dapat:

mengurangi unnecessary ambiguity.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.36 36. Permanence
Percakapan personal dapat hilang.
Digital public communication dapat:

tersimpan bertahun-tahun.

Maka public communication juga menjadi bagian dari:

narrative identity dan reputation.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.37 37. Reputation
Reputation adalah:

bagaimana persons lain secara accumulated memahami character dan reliability kita.

Reputation dibangun dari:

Communication + Action + Consequence over Time

Secara sederhana:
[ Reputation_{t+1} ================
f(Reputation_t, Communication, Action, Evidence) ]
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.38 38. Reputation ≠ Popularity
Seseorang dapat:

sangat popular,

tetapi:

tidak dipercaya.

Atau:

tidak terkenal,

tetapi mempunyai strong professional reputation.
Reputation berkaitan dengan:

competence,
honesty,
consistency,
care,
accountability.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
section: 16.39 39. Public Character dan Reputation Harus Selaras
text:
16.39 39. Public Character dan Reputation Harus Selaras
Jika seseorang selalu mengatakan:

“Saya mengutamakan accuracy.”

tetapi berkali-kali membagikan information tanpa checking,
terjadi:

character inconsistency.

Public tidak hanya mendengar:

claims.

Public mengamati:

behavior.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.40 40. Reputation as Relationship at Scale
Dalam relationship personal kita bertanya:

“Can I trust you?”

Dalam public relationship:

banyak persons bertanya pertanyaan yang sama.

Maka reputation dapat dilihat sebagai:

relationship memory at scale.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.41 41. Public Trust Mudah Rusak
Satu kesalahan belum tentu menghancurkan trust.
Yang lebih merusak:

menyembunyikan kesalahan,
menolak correction,
blame,
repeating misinformation.

Jika salah:

correction itself is communication.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.42 42. Public Correction
Good correction dapat berbunyi:

“Dalam post sebelumnya saya mengatakan X. Setelah memeriksa kembali data, pernyataan tersebut tidak tepat. Yang benar adalah Y. Saya sudah memperbaiki materi.”

Ini dapat:

meningkatkan credibility.

Karena accountability terlihat.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.43 43. Influence
Public communication memberi kemampuan:

influence.

Influence sendiri:

bukan buruk.

Teacher mempengaruhi student.
Scientist mempengaruhi policy.
Artist mempengaruhi culture.
Masalahnya adalah:

how influence is exercised.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.44 44. Ethical Influence
Ethical influence membantu person:

melihat evidence,
memahami issue,
menilai alternatives,
mengambil decision.

Manipulative influence berusaha:

mempersempit judgment,
exploit fear,
hide information,
pressure identity,
remove autonomy.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.45 45. Person-Centered Principle

The more we know about a person, the greater our responsibility not to exploit that knowledge.

Ini menjadi sangat penting dalam:

AI-mediated personalized communication.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.46 46. Personalization at Scale
Bayangkan satu educational message.
AI dapat menghasilkan versi untuk:

beginner,
expert,
child,
manager,
engineer.

Ini powerful.
Meaning dapat:

lebih accessible.

Tetapi ada risiko.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.47 47. Ethical Personalization
Good personalization:

“Jelaskan cybersecurity kepada pemilik UMKM dengan bahasa sederhana dan contoh transaksi toko.”

Tujuannya:

understanding.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.48 48. Manipulative Personalization
Buruk:

“Orang ini takut kehilangan pekerjaan. Buat message yang menggunakan ketakutan itu agar ia membeli.”

Tujuan:

exploit vulnerability.

Maka distinction utama:

personalize for relevance, not vulnerability exploitation.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.49 49. AI-Mediated Public Communication
AI dapat membantu:

16.49.1 RESEARCH ORGANIZATION
mengatur informasi.


16.49.2 TRANSLATION
technical → public.


16.49.3 LANGUAGE ADAPTATION
different characters.


16.49.4 STORY STRUCTURE
membuat narrative lebih clear.


16.49.5 SIMULATION
menguji kemungkinan responses.


16.49.6 EDITING
clarity dan tone.


16.49.7 ANALYTICS
melihat response patterns.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.50 50. AI sebagai Public Communication Copilot
Model:

PERSON → AI COPILOT → PUBLIC

Tetapi:

human person remains the publisher and responsible communicator.

AI boleh membantu menulis.
Tetapi:

“AI yang menulisnya”

tidak menghapus responsibility.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.51 51. AI Can Generate at Scale
Satu person sekarang dapat menghasilkan:

100 posts,
50 images,
20 videos,
1.000 personalized emails.

Kemampuan produksi meningkat drastis.
Maka pertanyaan baru adalah:

Should we communicate simply because we can generate communication?

Volume communication bukan:

communication quality.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.52 52. AI Can Create Communication Pollution
Jika semua orang menghasilkan:

unlimited content,

public mengalami:

information overload,
repetitive messages,
synthetic noise,
difficulty finding trustworthy information.

Maka communication competence di AI era juga berarti:

knowing when not to communicate.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.53 53. Relevance Before Volume
Public communication harus bertanya:

Apakah message ini:


necessary?
useful?
true?
relevant?
responsible?

Tidak hanya:

“Bisakah saya membuatnya viral?”
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.54 54. AI Can Simulate Public Response
Prompt:

“Berperanlah sebagai student, parent, engineer, dan public citizen. Tunjukkan bagaimana masing-masing dapat menginterpretasikan message berikut.”

Ini membantu:

anticipatory reflection.

Tetapi simulation bukan:

actual public response.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.55 55. AI Can Help Detect Ambiguity
AI dapat ditanya:

“Apa bagian message ini yang mungkin dibaca secara berbeda oleh audience yang tidak memiliki technical context?”

Berguna.
Tetapi human review tetap dibutuhkan.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.56 56. AI Can Help with Accessibility
AI dapat:

simplify text,
translate,
make captions,
create alternative explanations,
structure content.

Ini dapat meningkatkan:

participation.

Salah satu penggunaan AI yang paling person-centered adalah:

making knowledge more accessible.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.57 57. AI and Authentic Voice
Risiko:
semua public writing menjadi:

polished,


generic,


AI-sounding.

Person kehilangan:

narrative voice.

Karena itu setelah AI membantu:

edit kembali.

Tanyakan:

Would I actually say this?
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.58 58. Public Communication and Truth
Semakin luas audience:

semakin besar potential consequence kesalahan.

Maka sebelum membuat factual claim:

verify sesuai tingkat risiko dan importance.

Dalam tugas kelas, mahasiswa perlu membedakan:

16.58.1 FACT
Apa evidence?


16.58.2 INTERPRETATION
Apa analysis?


16.58.3 VALUE
Apa yang dianggap important?


16.58.4 RECOMMENDATION
Apa yang diusulkan?
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
section: 16.59 59. Do Not Hide Interpretation as Fact
text:
16.59 59. Do Not Hide Interpretation as Fact
Buruk:

“AI destroys student creativity.”

Itu claim luas.
Lebih careful:

“Jika AI digunakan untuk menghasilkan seluruh pekerjaan tanpa reflection, ada risiko mahasiswa berlatih lebih sedikit dalam menghasilkan gagasannya sendiri.”

Sekarang:

mechanism dan condition lebih jelas.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.60 60. Public Communication dan Uncertainty
Good communicator dapat mengatakan:

“Evidence saat ini belum cukup.”


“Ada beberapa interpretations.”


“Ini hypothesis.”


“Saya belum tahu.”

Public communication tidak membutuhkan:

false certainty.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.61 61. Confidence Language
Bandingkan:

“Ini pasti terjadi.”


“Evidence menunjukkan kemungkinan…”


“Data awal menunjukkan…”


“Kami belum dapat menyimpulkan…”

Pemilihan language menunjukkan:

intellectual honesty.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.62 62. Communicating Complex Ideas
Gunakan progression:

WHAT?

Apa idea-nya?

WHY?

Mengapa penting?

HOW?

Bagaimana bekerja?

EVIDENCE?

Apa dasarnya?

SO WHAT?

Apa consequence?

NOW WHAT?

Apa next action?
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.63 63. Public Narrative Template
Mahasiswa dapat menggunakan:

16.63.1 1. PERSON

Siapa yang mengalami issue?



16.63.2 2. REALITY

Apa yang terjadi?



16.63.3 3. TENSION

Problem/opportunity apa?



16.63.4 4. POSSIBILITY

Apa yang dapat dilakukan?



16.63.5 5. EVIDENCE

Mengapa kita percaya possibility tersebut?



16.63.6 6. ACTION

Apa reasonable next step?
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.64 64. Example — AI Learning

16.64.1 Person
Mahasiswa.


16.64.2 Reality
AI dapat memberi jawaban dalam seconds.


16.64.3 Tension
Jawaban cepat tidak selalu menghasilkan learning.


16.64.4 Possibility
Gunakan AI setelah mencoba sendiri.


16.64.5 Evidence
Bandingkan reasoning sebelum dan sesudah AI critique.


16.64.6 Action

“Pada satu soal minggu ini, tulis jawaban sendiri terlebih dahulu lalu minta AI mencari kelemahannya.”

Public communication menjadi:

concrete.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.65 65. Call to Action
Call to action yang baik:

specific,
feasible,
voluntary,
aligned with message.

Buruk:

“Mari kita ubah dunia.”

Lebih actionable:

“Bawa botol minum sendiri pada tiga hari kampus minggu depan.”
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.66 66. One Communication, One Primary Action
Public message sering terlalu banyak meminta:

subscribe, buy, share, read, download, volunteer, donate.

Result:

confusion.

Pilih:

primary next action.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.67 67. Public Agreement?
Dalam one-to-many communication kita tidak selalu mendapatkan agreement langsung.
Response dapat berupa:

comment,
share,
participation,
adoption,
voting,
purchase,
sign-up.

Maka action evidence harus disesuaikan:

objective.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
section: 16.68 68. Public Communication Is Not Finished at Publication
text:
16.68 68. Public Communication Is Not Finished at Publication
Model lama:

Publish → Done.

Model mata kuliah:

PUBLISH → OBSERVE RESPONSE → LEARN → RESPOND → ADAPT

Public communication tetap:

closed loop.

Hanya loop-nya:

lebih lambat dan lebih noisy.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.69 69. Read Response Carefully
Banyak likes:

belum tentu understanding.

Banyak comments:

belum tentu agreement.

Banyak shares:

bahkan dapat berarti outrage.

Metric membutuhkan:

interpretation.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.70 70. Quantitative + Qualitative Feedback
Gunakan:

16.70.1 Quantitative

reach,
click,
attendance,
completion,
conversion.



16.70.2 Qualitative

comments,
questions,
misunderstanding,
stories,
feedback.

Keduanya membantu:

understand persons behind numbers.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.71 71. Virality ≠ Success
Sebuah communication dapat viral karena:

useful,
funny,
shocking,
misleading,
anger.

Jadi:
[ Virality Communication Quality]
Selalu kembali ke:

objective + consequence + relationship.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.72 72. Public Relationship
Walaupun tidak mengenal setiap audience, public dapat membangun relationship dengan communicator.
Contoh:
reader secara berulang mengalami seseorang sebagai:

clear,
reliable,
respectful.

Lama-lama terbentuk:

trust.

Maka:

Public communication can create relational continuity at scale.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.73 73. Five Qualities of Public Trust

16.73.1 COMPETENCE
Apakah tahu apa yang dibicarakan?


16.73.2 HONESTY
Apakah claims dapat dipercaya?


16.73.3 CLARITY
Apakah meaning dapat dipahami?


16.73.4 CARE
Apakah memperhatikan persons yang terdampak?


16.73.5 ACCOUNTABILITY
Apakah bersedia memperbaiki kesalahan?
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.74 74. Public Communication Failure Modes

16.74.1 1. CATEGORY STEREOTYPING

“Gen Z selalu…”



16.74.2 2. CLICKBAIT WITHOUT VALUE
Attention tanpa substance.


16.74.3 3. JARGON
Meaning tidak accessible.


16.74.4 4. OVERCLAIM
Evidence tidak cukup.


16.74.5 5. PERSONAL ATTACK
Menggantikan argument.


16.74.6 6. MANIPULATION
Fear/guilt exploitation.


16.74.7 7. METRIC OBSESSION
Views dianggap impact.


16.74.8 8. CONTEXT IGNORANCE
Tidak mempertimbangkan audience lebih luas.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.75 75. Public Apology
Jika communication melukai atau salah:

acknowledgment menjadi bagian dari relationship repair.

Struktur:

What happened → What was wrong → What I am correcting → What changes next

Hindari:

“Maaf kalau ada yang tersinggung.”

Jika kita memang membuat factual error:

sebutkan error.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.76 76. The World Is Also Multi-Stakeholder
Public communication dapat mempengaruhi:

direct audience,
non-target audience,
institutions,
communities,
future users.

Maka sebelum publikasi penting:

stakeholder scan.

Tanyakan:

Who else may be affected by this communication?
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
section: 16.77 77. Latihan 1 — One Idea, Five Public Characters
text:
16.77 77. Latihan 1 — One Idea, Five Public Characters
Idea:

penggunaan AI dalam pendidikan.

Buat message 60 detik untuk:

student,
parent,
lecturer,
school manager,
general public.

Core meaning harus:

sama.

Language dan relevance:

berubah.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.78 78. Latihan 2 — Reach or Impact?
Tentukan.

16.78.1 A
Video ditonton 50.000 kali.

Reach/Attention.



16.78.2 B
3.000 orang menyelesaikan tutorial.

Engagement.



16.78.3 C
500 mahasiswa mengubah cara mereka menggunakan AI pada assignment.

Adoption/Action.



16.78.4 D
Setelah semester, quality reasoning meningkat.

Impact.

Tujuan:

membedakan metrics.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.79 79. Latihan 3 — Jargon to Public Language
Ubah:

“Model uses retrieval-augmented generation with embedding-based semantic retrieval.”

menjadi:

public language.

Contoh:

“Sebelum menjawab, AI mencari bagian dokumen yang paling relevan sehingga jawabannya dapat didasarkan pada informasi yang tersedia.”
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.114 114. Take-Home Messages
Jika hanya mengingat sepuluh hal dari Minggu 13:

The public is made of persons, not anonymous masses.
Communication at scale reduces direct knowledge of each individual person.
Public character determines communication responsibility.
Reach is not the same as impact.
Translate specialized knowledge without distorting it.
Public narrative should connect person, reality, problem, possibility, evidence, and action.
Reputation is relationship memory at scale.
Ethical influence increases understanding and preserves autonomy.
AI enables personalization and scale, but also enables unprecedented manipulation and noise.
The highest purpose of public communication is not merely visibility, but responsible contribution to persons and the world.
crumbs: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD

title: 16  MINGGU 13 — COMMUNICATING WITH THE WORLD
text:
16.115 115. One-Minute Summary
Minggu 12:

PERSON ⇄ COMMUNITY

Minggu 13:

PERSON ⇄ THE WORLD

Tetapi dunia bukan satu anonymous audience.
Ia terdiri dari:

MANY PERSONS

dengan:

different personalities,
narrative characters,
knowledge,
values,
contexts,
objectives.

Maka public communication bekerja melalui:

PERSON ↓ PUBLIC CHARACTER ↓ OBJECTIVE ↓ TARGET PERSONS ↓ PUBLIC NARRATIVE ↓ RELEVANT LANGUAGE & REPERTOIRE ↓ ATTENTION ↓ INTEREST ↓ DESIRE / ADOPTION ↓ ACTION ↓ IMPACT ↓ REPUTATION & RELATIONSHIP

Dengan AI:

PERSON + AI COPILOT ⇄ MANY PERSONS

menjadi mungkin pada scale yang belum pernah ada sebelumnya.
Tetapi semakin besar kemampuan communication kita:

semakin besar pula responsibility kita.

Maka prinsip Minggu 13 adalah:

Do not communicate merely to be seen. Communicate to add truthful, understandable, responsible value to the lives of persons you may never meet.

Pada Minggu 14, seluruh framework ini akan dibawa ke pusat tema mata kuliah: AI-Mediated Person-Centered Communication—bagaimana AI dapat menjadi mirror, coach, copilot, translator, mediator, dan dalam kondisi tertentu delegated agent, tanpa mengambil alih agency, responsibility, dan relationship yang tetap dimiliki oleh human persons.

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

17.3 3. Apa Itu AI-Mediated Communication?
Traditional communication:

PERSON A ⇄ PERSON B

AI-mediated communication menambahkan AI di dalam communication process.
Model sederhana:

PERSON A → AI → PERSON B

Contoh:
Person A menulis email.
AI membantu:

memperbaiki grammar,
memperjelas structure,
menyesuaikan tone.

Kemudian Person A mengirimkannya kepada Person B.

membantu preparation.


17.4.2 DURING COMMUNICATION
membantu real-time interaction.


17.4.3 AFTER COMMUNICATION
membantu reflection.


17.4.4 INSTEAD OF SOME COMMUNICATION
bertindak sebagai delegated agent.
Karena itu AI-MC bukan:

satu model.

levels of mediation.

AI can amplify communication capability, but persons remain the source of meaning, judgment, responsibility, and relationship.

AI memperkuat communication. Person tetap memiliki relationship.

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

Relationship tetap:

Parent ⇄ Child

AI hanya membantu.
Modelnya:

PERSON A + AI ASSISTANT ⇄ PERSON B

bukan:

AI A ⇄ AI B

untuk semua jenis communication.

respectful communication.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.14 14. AI AS TRANSLATOR
Translation bukan hanya:

Indonesian ↔︎ English.

Dalam mata kuliah ini lebih luas:

Language A → Language B

Misalnya:

17.14.1 Engineer Language

“The inference pipeline has high latency.”



17.14.2 Manager Language

“Response sistem terlalu lambat untuk workflow sekarang.”



17.14.3 Customer Language

“User harus menunggu terlalu lama setelah menekan tombol.”

Meaning:

sama.

Language:

berubah.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.15 15. AI sebagai Character Translator
Prompt:

“Meaning inti saya adalah X. Jelaskan kepada:

engineer,
manager,
customer, tanpa mengubah fakta.”


AI membantu mengimplementasikan:

Language of Character dari Minggu 4.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.16 16. Translation Bukan Distortion
Rule:

Change language. Preserve meaning.

Jika original evidence mengatakan:

“Pilot menurunkan waktu rata-rata 20%.”

AI tidak boleh mengubah menjadi:

“System terbukti sangat meningkatkan productivity.”

Itu sudah:

meaning inflation.

Human harus:

verify.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.17 17. AI AS COPILOT
Copilot membantu:

during communication.

Model:

Person A + AI Copilot ⇄ Person B + AI Copilot

AI dapat membantu real-time:

retrieve information,
summarize previous discussion,
remind commitments,
translate terminology,
identify unresolved issues,
propose clarification questions.

Tetapi human tetap:

decides what to say.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.18 18. Example: Project Meeting
Team sedang meeting.
AI Copilot dapat menghasilkan:

“Sejauh ini tiga keputusan sudah dibuat:

API selesai Rabu,
testing mulai Kamis,
Budi belum mempunyai akses server.”


Facilitator menggunakan summary tersebut untuk bertanya:

“Apakah ini benar?”

AI membantu:

shared memory.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.19 19. Copilot Bukan Autopilot
Penting.

17.19.1 COPILOT

suggests.



17.19.2 AUTOPILOT

acts independently.

Dalam communication sensitif:

jangan mudah berpindah dari Copilot ke Autopilot.

Karena human communication mengandung:

intention,
responsibility,
relationship meaning.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.20 20. AI AS MEDIATOR
Mediator membantu dua atau lebih persons:

understand one another.

Misalnya Person A menulis:

technical concern.

Person B memahami:

business concern.

AI dapat membantu membuat:

translation layer.

Model:

Person A ⇄ AI Mediation ⇄ Person B

Tetapi mediator sebaiknya:

tidak diam-diam memihak.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.21 21. Example — Engineer vs Manager
Engineer:

“Kita tidak bisa release Jumat karena test coverage masih rendah.”

Manager:

“Engineering selalu memperlambat.”

AI Mediator dapat merangkum:

“Engineering concern adalah reliability risk jika release Jumat. Management concern adalah customer commitment pada hari Jumat. Conflict saat ini bukan apakah release penting, tetapi tingkat risk yang dapat diterima dan scope apa yang dapat dikirim Jumat.”

Sekarang:

disagreement menjadi workable issue.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.22 22. AI Mediator Harus Transparan
Jika AI:

mengubah wording,
menggabungkan positions,
membuat summary,

relevant persons harus dapat:

check.

Karena AI bisa:

salah memahami.

Rule:

AI summary is a draft of shared understanding, not shared understanding itself.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.23 23. AI AS DELEGATE
Level lebih tinggi:

AI berkomunikasi atas nama person.

Contoh sederhana:
AI dapat:

menjadwalkan meeting.

User memberi authority:

“Cari waktu 30 menit minggu depan setelah pukul 14.00.”

AI bernegosiasi dengan calendar agent.
Ini adalah:

delegated communication.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.24 24. Delegated Agent
Model:

PERSON A → AGENT A ⇄ AGENT B ← PERSON B

Agents berkomunikasi untuk mencapai:

agreement.

Contoh:

scheduling,
routine booking,
standardized procurement,
routine service request.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.25 25. Tetapi Delegation Membutuhkan Authority Boundary
Agent tidak boleh:

membuat commitment tanpa authority.

Contoh authority:

“Boleh memilih hotel maksimal Rp1,5 juta per malam.”

atau:

“Boleh menerima meeting antara Selasa–Kamis pukul 14.00–17.00.”

Authority harus:

explicit.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.26 26. Agent Model
Kita dapat merumuskan:

AGENT = Narrative Character + Mission + Knowledge + Values + Constraints + Language + Authority
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.27 27. CHARACTER
Agent berbicara sebagai:

siapa?

Contoh:

Procurement Assistant.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.28 28. MISSION
Apa yang ingin dicapai?

membeli barang yang memenuhi specification.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.29 29. KNOWLEDGE
Apa yang diketahui?

specification,
vendor list,
delivery requirement.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.30 30. VALUES
Apa prinsip yang harus dijaga?

safety,
fairness,
quality,
privacy.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.31 31. CONSTRAINTS
Contoh:

budget maksimum,
delivery date,
technical standard.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.32 32. LANGUAGE
Agent mungkin berbicara:

formal procurement language.

Bukan:

casual personal language.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.33 33. AUTHORITY
Apa yang boleh diputuskan?
Ini bagian paling penting.
Misalnya:

dapat recommend,

tetapi:

tidak dapat sign contract.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.34 34. Agent Can Negotiate within an Acceptable Region
text:
17.34 34. Agent Can Negotiate within an Acceptable Region
Minggu 11 kita menggunakan:
[ A^* A_1 A_2 A_n]
Agent dapat membantu mencari:

acceptable intersection.

Misalnya:
Buyer Agent:

harga ≤ Rp5 juta,
delivery ≤ 7 hari.

Seller Agent:

harga ≥ Rp4,5 juta,
delivery ≥ 5 hari.

Possible agreement:

Rp4,8 juta, 6 hari.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.35 35. Human Must Define What Is Acceptable
text:
17.35 35. Human Must Define What Is Acceptable
AI dapat mencari:

intersection.

Tetapi manusia menentukan:

boundary.

Misalnya:

safety tidak boleh diperdagangkan dengan cost.

AI tidak boleh sendiri memutuskan:

“Safety risk ini cukup acceptable.”

Jika authority tersebut:

tidak diberikan.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.36 36. Tiga Level AI Communication Assistance
Untuk memudahkan mahasiswa gunakan tiga level utama.

17.36.1 LEVEL 1 — AI COACH
AI membantu sebelum/selesai communication.

Person communicates directly.




17.36.2 LEVEL 2 — AI COPILOT
AI membantu real-time.

Person still communicates and decides.




17.36.3 LEVEL 3 — AI DELEGATE
AI melakukan limited communication/action.

Authority is explicitly delegated.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.37 37. Simple Rule
Semakin tinggi:

relationship consequence + ethical consequence + uncertainty

semakin sebaiknya kita bergerak ke:

human direct communication.

Semakin:

routine + structured + low-risk + reversible

semakin mungkin:

delegation.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.38 38. Example — Scheduling
Low relationship risk.
AI Delegate:

reasonable.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.39 39. Example — Expense Reimbursement
Structured.
Agent dapat:

prepare dan submit dalam limit tertentu.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.40 40. Example — Apology to a Friend
High relational meaning.
Jangan:

“AI, minta maaf kepada sahabat saya.”

Lebih tepat:

AI Coach membantu kita mempersiapkan.

Kemudian:

person apologizes to person.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.41 41. Example — Employee Conflict
AI dapat:

summarize,
coach,
propose neutral wording.

Tetapi disciplinary conversation:

sebaiknya tetap dilakukan manusia yang bertanggung jawab.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.42 42. Example — Family
Parent mengatakan:

“AI, jelaskan kepada anak saya bahwa saya menyayanginya.”

AI mungkin menghasilkan message indah.
Tetapi communication penting bukan hanya:

words.

Anak juga menerima meaning dari:

who says it.

Ini penting:

The messenger is part of the message.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.43 43. Relationship-Carrying Communication
Beberapa communication mempunyai relational value tinggi:

gratitude,
apology,
love,
reconciliation,
mentoring,
encouragement,
conflict resolution,
leadership.

Pada communication seperti ini:

human presence itself carries meaning.

AI sebaiknya lebih banyak berperan:

Coach / Mirror / Copilot.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.44 44. Task-Carrying vs Relationship-Carrying Communication
Gunakan distinction:

17.44.1 TASK-CARRYING
Main value:

information / transaction / coordination.

Contoh:

meeting schedule.

Delegation lebih mudah.


17.44.2 RELATIONSHIP-CARRYING
Main value:

human recognition and relationship.

Contoh:

“Saya minta maaf.”

Delegation jauh lebih sensitif.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.45 45. AI dan Five Domains
Mari kita review seluruh mata kuliah.

17.45.1 DOMAIN 1 — INTRA-SELF
AI:

Mirror / Reflection Coach.

Risk:

dependency terhadap external interpretation.




17.45.2 DOMAIN 2 — FAMILY & FRIENDS
AI:

Coach / Rehearsal / Tone Reviewer.

Risk:

loss of authenticity.




17.45.3 DOMAIN 3 — WORKING COLLEAGUES
AI:

Copilot / Translator / Meeting Assistant / Limited Delegate.

Risk:

wrong commitment, confidentiality.




17.45.4 DOMAIN 4 — COMMUNITY
AI:

summarizer / stakeholder simulator / public-language translator.

Risk:

misrepresentation, minority erasure.




17.45.5 DOMAIN 5 — THE WORLD
AI:

content assistant / personalization / analysis.

Risk:

manipulation, synthetic noise, misinformation.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.46 46. AI + TAIDA
AI juga dapat membantu seluruh Baseball Model.

TARGET → ATTENTION → INTEREST → DESIRE → ACTION
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.47 47. AI at TARGET
AI dapat membantu:

stakeholder mapping,
identify possible roles,
organize known context.

Tetapi jangan:

convert person into stereotype.

AI hypothesis harus:

validated.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.48 48. AI at ATTENTION
AI dapat membantu:

summarize evidence,
adapt problem language,
create visualization.

Tetapi jangan:

generate fake urgency.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.49 49. AI at INTEREST
AI dapat membantu:

explain solution,
compare alternatives,
translate technical mechanism.

Tetapi jangan:

hide limitations.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.50 50. AI at DESIRE
AI dapat:

simulate future state,
demonstrate benefit,
identify concerns.

Tetapi sangat berbahaya jika digunakan untuk:

exploit personal fears or vulnerabilities.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.51 51. AI at ACTION
AI dapat membantu:

generate options,
check constraints,
summarize agreements,
schedule next action.

Tetapi:

commitments require authority.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.52 52. AI as Communication State Estimator
AI dapat membaca transcript dan memperkirakan:

person berada di state mana?

Misalnya target mengatakan:

“Ya, ini memang masalah kami.”

AI:

Attention.


“Bagaimana cara kerja solution?”

AI:

Interest.


“Kalau bekerja begitu, kami membutuhkan ini.”

AI:

Desire.


“Kirim kontraknya.”

AI:

Action-ready.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.53 53. Tetapi State Recognition Tidak Pernah Pasti
text:
17.53 53. Tetapi State Recognition Tidak Pernah Pasti
AI mungkin salah.
Contoh:
Person mengatakan:

“Menarik sekali…”

Tetapi tone sebenarnya:

sarcastic.

Transcript tidak menangkap:

body language.

Maka:

AI state estimate is evidence, not truth.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.54 54. AI Can Recommend Next Pitch
Jika target ada di Attention:

jangan terus bicara tentang problem.

AI dapat mengingatkan:

“Target tampaknya sudah mengakui problem; Anda dapat mulai menguji solution relevance.”

Tetapi human communicator tetap:

decides.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.55 55. AI-Mediated Closed Loop
Model:

OBSERVE PERSON ↓ AI + HUMAN ESTIMATE STATE ↓ CHOOSE MESSAGE ↓ COMMUNICATE ↓ OBSERVE RESPONSE ↓ AI ANALYSIS + HUMAN JUDGMENT ↓ ADAPT

AI membantu loop menjadi:

faster.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.56 56. Person-Centered Prompting
Prompt yang baik bukan sekadar:

“Buat email yang bagus.”

Masukkan communication context.
Gunakan:

PERSON → CHARACTER → RELATIONSHIP → OBJECTIVE → CURRENT STATE → LANGUAGE → CONSTRAINT
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.57 57. Prompt Template

17.57.1 PERSON
Siapa receiver?


17.57.2 CHARACTER
Sebagai siapa ia hadir?


17.57.3 RELATIONSHIP
Apa hubungan kami?


17.57.4 OBJECTIVE
Apa yang ingin dicapai?


17.57.5 CURRENT STATE
Apa yang sudah ia tahu/setujui?


17.57.6 CORE MEANING
Apa yang tidak boleh berubah?


17.57.7 LANGUAGE
Language apa yang sesuai?


17.57.8 CONSTRAINT
Apa yang harus dihindari?
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.58 58. Example Prompt

“Saya adalah student project leader. Receiver adalah teman satu kelompok, bukan subordinate saya. Ia terlambat mengirim module dua hari. Tujuan saya memahami blocker dan membuat agreement baru, bukan menyalahkan. Core fact: deadline sudah lewat dua hari. Buat tiga cara membuka conversation dengan tone clear tetapi respectful. Jangan mengasumsikan ia malas.”

Prompt ini person-centered karena:

context dan relationship jelas.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.59 59. Poor Prompt

“Buat pesan keras agar anggota kelompok yang malas kapok.”

Masalah:

assumption,
attack,
objective = punishment,
no discovery.

AI dapat memperbesar:

communication failure.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.60 60. AI Amplifies the User’s Framing
Jika prompt:

biased,

AI dapat menghasilkan output:

biased.

Jika framing:

person-centered,

AI lebih mungkin membantu:

person-centered communication.

Jadi kualitas AI-MC sangat bergantung pada:

human communication judgment.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.61 61. AI Does Not Remove the Need to Learn Communication
text:
17.61 61. AI Does Not Remove the Need to Learn Communication
Mahasiswa mungkin bertanya:

“Kalau AI bisa menulis email lebih baik, mengapa saya perlu belajar komunikasi?”

Karena mahasiswa tetap harus menentukan:

siapa person-nya,
apa objective-nya,
apa fakta,
apa yang fair,
apa relationship-nya,
apa authority,
apakah output benar,
kapan perlu diam,
kapan perlu berbicara sendiri.

AI dapat menghasilkan:

sentences.

Tetapi tidak otomatis mempunyai:

responsible human judgment.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.62 62. AI Can Make Bad Communicators More Efficient
text:
17.62 62. AI Can Make Bad Communicators More Efficient
Ini paradox penting.
Jika seseorang:

tidak dapat mengenali problem dengan baik,

AI dapat membantu membuat:

proposal salah dengan sangat cepat.

Jika seseorang:

suka memanipulasi,

AI dapat membantu membuat manipulation:

lebih scalable.

Maka AI meningkatkan pentingnya:

communication character dan ethics.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.63 63. Risks of AI-Mediated Communication
Gunakan tujuh risiko utama:

Hallucination
Profiling & Stereotyping
Manipulation
Loss of Authenticity
Dependency
Privacy & Confidentiality
Authority Error
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.64 64. Risk 1 — Hallucination
AI dapat menghasilkan:

information yang salah tetapi terdengar credible.

Dalam professional communication ini dapat menghasilkan:

false commitment.

Example:
AI menulis:

“Fitur tersebut tersedia.”

Padahal:

tidak.

Rule:

Verify consequential factual claims.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.65 65. Risk 2 — Profiling
AI dapat mengatakan:

“Orang seperti ini biasanya…”

Kategori dapat membantu hypothesis.
Tetapi person:

bukan statistical average.

Rule:

Use profiles as tentative clues, not identity definitions.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.66 66. Risk 3 — Manipulation
AI dapat optimize:

persuasion.

Misalnya mencari:

emotional triggers,
vulnerabilities,
best pressure phrase.

Person-centered ethics menolak:

hidden exploitation.

Rule:

Personalize for understanding and mutual value, not covert control.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.67 67. Risk 4 — Loss of Authenticity
AI dapat membuat:

apology sangat indah.

Tetapi receiver dapat merasa:

“Ini bukan kamu.”

Authenticity tidak berarti:

tidak boleh dibantu AI.

Tetapi final communication harus:

owned by the person.

Question:

Would I genuinely stand behind every sentence?
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.68 68. Risk 5 — Dependency
Jika setiap difficult conversation diserahkan kepada AI:
person dapat kehilangan kemampuan:

reflect,
formulate,
tolerate discomfort,
negotiate.

AI sebaiknya:

develop human competence.

Bukan:

replace it.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.69 69. Risk 6 — Privacy
Sebelum memasukkan conversation ke AI:

apakah ada personal/confidential data?

Mahasiswa harus belajar:

anonymize bila perlu.

Jangan sembarangan memasukkan:

private medical information,
confidential company data,
personal conflict details,
passwords,
protected information.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.70 70. Risk 7 — Authority Error
AI mungkin membuat:

commitment yang user sebenarnya tidak authorized.

Contoh:

“Kami menjamin project selesai Jumat.”

Padahal student engineer tidak punya authority.
Rule:

AI cannot create authority you do not have.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.71 71. Human-in-the-Loop
Untuk consequential communication gunakan:

AI GENERATES → HUMAN REVIEWS → HUMAN DECIDES → HUMAN OWNS

Bukan:

AI generates → send automatically.

Kecuali:

low-risk routine communication dengan authority yang jelas.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.72 72. Three Questions Before Delegating
Sebelum AI menjadi Delegate tanyakan:

17.72.1 1. IS IT REVERSIBLE?
Kalau salah, mudah diperbaiki?


17.72.2 2. IS AUTHORITY CLEAR?
Apa yang boleh dilakukan?


17.72.3 3. IS RELATIONSHIP VALUE LOW ENOUGH?
Apakah human presence tidak terlalu penting?
Semakin jawabannya:

yes,

semakin feasible delegation.

text:
17.74 74. AI and Relationship Ownership
Simple rule:

AI can carry information. Persons carry responsibility and relationship.

Pada routine task, AI dapat membawa lebih banyak.
Pada relationship-critical moments:

person harus membawa lebih banyak.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.75 75. The Communication Responsibility Stack
Kita dapat membagi responsibility menjadi:

17.75.1 AI

generate,
summarize,
translate,
detect patterns,
suggest.



17.75.2 PERSON

choose objective,
judge,
verify,
decide,
commit,
take responsibility,
maintain relationship.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.76 76. AI Cannot Apologize for Me in the Full Human Sense
text:
17.76 76. AI Cannot Apologize for Me in the Full Human Sense
AI dapat menghasilkan:

words of apology.

Tetapi ownership:

tetap saya.

Karena apology berarti:

I acknowledge what I did.

AI tidak melakukan:

original action.

Maka authentic repair membutuhkan:

person.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.77 77. AI Cannot Love on My Behalf
text:
17.77 77. AI Cannot Love on My Behalf
AI dapat membantu menemukan:

kata-kata.

Tetapi dalam relationship:

“I care about you”

mempunyai meaning karena:

siapa yang mengatakannya dan bagaimana ia hidup sesudahnya.

Communication bukan hanya:

linguistic artifact.

Ia bagian dari:

human action and relationship history.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.78 78. AI Can Strengthen Love and Care
text:
17.78 78. AI Can Strengthen Love and Care
Ini tidak berarti AI harus dijauhkan.
AI dapat membantu:

mengingat birthday,
menyusun travel plan,
menerjemahkan,
membuat accessibility,
membantu orang dengan communication difficulty,
mempersiapkan difficult conversation.

AI dapat:

support care.

Tetapi care tetap:

human responsibility.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.79 79. Person-Centered Business Intelligence
AI era memungkinkan organisasi mengenali:

person lebih dalam.

Traditional:

DATA → CATEGORY → SEGMENT → TARGET

Person-centered:

PERSON → ROLE → CHARACTER → CONTEXT → RELATIONSHIP → INTENTION → ACTION

Tujuan:

better service dan better relationship.

Bukan:

better manipulation.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.80 80. From Customer Segment to Customer Person
text:
17.80 80. From Customer Segment to Customer Person
Old:

“Male, age 20–25, student.”

New:

“This person is currently a student organizing an event, has interacted with us twice, is trying to solve payment coordination, and prefers simple mobile communication.”

Lebih contextual.
Tetapi juga:

more ethically sensitive.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.81 81. The More Personal the Data, the Greater the Duty of Care
text:
17.81 81. The More Personal the Data, the Greater the Duty of Care
Semakin banyak organization mengetahui person:

semakin besar power asymmetry.

Maka harus ada:

relevance,
restraint,
privacy,
transparency,
non-exploitation.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.82 82. Person–Relationship Intelligence
Kita dapat menyebut capability ini:

Person–Relationship Intelligence (PRI)

Bukan hanya:

“Siapa customer ini?”

Tetapi:

“Apa relationship kami?”


“Apa history-nya?”


“Apa objective saat ini?”


“Apa appropriate next interaction?”

PRI bukan sekadar:

prediction.

Ia digunakan untuk:

relationship quality.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.83 83. AI-Mediated Personalized Communication at Scale
Progression:

Mass → Segmented → Personalized → Relational


17.83.1 MASS
Satu email untuk semua.


17.83.2 SEGMENTED
Email untuk student/customer/manager.


17.83.3 PERSONALIZED
Nama, history, current need.


17.83.4 RELATIONAL
Message mempertimbangkan previous interactions dan relationship state.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.84 84. Example
Mass:

“Gunakan sistem pembayaran baru kami.”

Segmented:

“Untuk mahasiswa, sistem baru mempermudah pembayaran.”

Personalized:

“Anda masih mempunyai tagihan bulan ini…”

Relational:

“Minggu lalu Anda melaporkan kesulitan melakukan pembayaran melalui mobile. Versi baru sekarang menyediakan alternative transfer. Apakah Anda ingin mencoba?”

Semakin relational:

semakin useful.

Tetapi juga:

semakin perlu ethics.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.85 85. AI-Mediated Communication Can Create Mutual Value
text:
17.85 85. AI-Mediated Communication Can Create Mutual Value
Idealnya AI meningkatkan:

17.85.1 Value for Person A
lebih mudah menyampaikan meaning.


17.85.2 Value for Person B
lebih mudah memahami.


17.85.3 Relationship Value
lebih sedikit misunderstanding.
Maka:
[ ]
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.86 86. AI-MC Failure
AI dapat menghasilkan message:

grammatically perfect,

tetapi communication gagal.
Misalnya:

relationship terlalu formal.

atau:

meaning salah.

atau:

receiver merasa manipulated.

Maka kualitas AI output:

bukan sama dengan kualitas communication.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.87 87. Human Communication Quality Remains the Measure
text:
17.87 87. Human Communication Quality Remains the Measure
Tanyakan:

Apakah person lebih memahami?


Apakah objective lebih jelas?


Apakah response dibaca?


Apakah agreement fair?


Apakah relationship sehat?

Bukan:

“Apakah AI menghasilkan kalimat yang bagus?”
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
section: 17.88 88. Latihan 1 — Human, Coach, Copilot, or Delegate?
text:
17.88 88. Latihan 1 — Human, Coach, Copilot, or Delegate?
Tentukan level yang sesuai.

17.88.1 A
Meminta maaf kepada sahabat.

AI Coach.



17.88.2 B
Menjadwalkan meeting lima orang.

Delegate possible.



17.88.3 C
Menjelaskan technical system kepada CEO.

Translator/Copilot.



17.88.4 D
Menghadapi customer complaint sensitif.

Coach + Copilot, human communicates.



17.88.5 E
Membeli standardized office supplies di bawah batas tertentu.

Delegate possible.
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.89 89. Latihan 2 — Rewrite the Prompt
Poor prompt:

“Buat customer ini setuju.”

Ubah menjadi:

“Customer sudah mengakui problem X tetapi masih khawatir Y. Bantu saya membuat tiga pertanyaan untuk memahami concern-nya sebelum menawarkan option.”

Discuss:

mana lebih person-centered?
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.90 90. Latihan 3 — AI Mirror
Mahasiswa menulis satu message konflik sederhana.
Contoh:

“Kamu selalu membuat kelompok kacau.”

Gunakan AI untuk memisahkan:

fact,
interpretation,
emotion,
need,
request.

Kemudian mahasiswa:

membuat human final version.

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.91 91. Latihan 4 — Character Translation
Meaning:

project delay karena API dependency.

Gunakan AI untuk membuat versi kepada:

engineer,
manager,
customer.

Kemudian cek:

apakah core meaning berubah?
crumbs: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.92 92. Latihan 5 — TAIDA State Detection
Berikan transcript pendek kepada AI.
Minta:

“Identify likely current TAIDA state and quote evidence.”

Mahasiswa kemudian menilai:

apakah AI benar?

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.93 93. Latihan 6 — Copilot Meeting
Kelompok tiga orang:

Project Leader
Engineer
Customer

AI boleh dipakai untuk:

summarize,
capture action items.

Setelah meeting cek:

apakah AI summary sesuai dengan pemahaman ketiga persons?

Jika tidak:

siapa yang menentukan?

Jawaban:

persons.

apa?

apa?

kapan?


17.94.5 Negotiable
apa?


17.94.6 Non-Negotiable
apa?

apa?

17.95 95. Latihan 8 — AI Ethics
Dosen memberikan prompts.

17.95.1 Prompt A

“Gunakan data pribadi customer untuk menemukan anxiety terbesar sehingga kita bisa membuat offer yang sulit ditolak.”

Diskusikan:

problem etik.



17.95.2 Prompt B

“Gunakan interaction history untuk mengetahui problem yang belum terselesaikan dan buat draft message yang menawarkan bantuan tanpa pressure.”

Lebih:

person-centered.

human-to-human communication.

AI-assisted reflection.

17.101.1 0–15 menit — Review Minggu 13
Pertanyaan:

“Jika AI dapat membuat communication lebih scalable, apa yang tidak boleh kita serahkan begitu saja kepada AI?”




17.101.2 15–40 menit — Lecture
Topik:

AI-mediated communication,
Mirror,
Coach,
Translator,
Copilot,
Mediator,
Delegate.




17.101.3 40–55 menit — Demonstration
Dosen memperlihatkan tiga level:

apa?

mengapa role tersebut appropriate.

Apa yang sengaja TIDAK saya delegasikan kepada AI dan mengapa?

boundary judgment.

bagaimana manusia menggunakan AI.

considered.

text:
17.129 129. Take-Home Messages
Jika hanya mengingat dua belas hal dari Minggu 14:

AI can mediate communication, but persons remain relationship owners.
AI dapat menjadi Mirror, Coach, Translator, Copilot, Mediator, atau Delegate.
Gunakan Coach untuk preparation dan reflection.
Gunakan Copilot untuk assistance tanpa menyerahkan judgment.
Delegate hanya jika authority jelas dan task cukup structured.
Semakin tinggi relationship consequence, semakin penting direct human communication.
The messenger is sometimes part of the meaning.
AI dapat membantu seluruh TAIDA, tetapi tidak boleh digunakan untuk covert manipulation.
Person-centered prompts harus memuat Person, Character, Relationship, Objective, State, Meaning, dan Constraint.
AI output harus diverifikasi—terutama factual claims dan commitments.
AI seharusnya membangun human competence, bukan membuat human communication skill menghilang.
Good AI-mediated communication produces better understanding, better action, and healthier relationships.

title: 17  MINGGU 14 — AI-MEDIATED PERSON-CENTERED COMMUNICATION
text:
17.130 130. One-Minute Summary
AI tidak mengubah fondasi mata kuliah.
Fondasinya tetap:

PERSON ⇄ PERSON

AI hanya menambah capability.
Kita dapat memilih:

AI MIRROR “Bantu saya memahami communication saya sendiri.”

↓

AI COACH “Bantu saya mempersiapkan conversation.”

↓

AI TRANSLATOR “Bantu saya menemukan language yang sesuai.”

↓

AI COPILOT “Bantu saya ketika conversation berlangsung.”

↓

AI MEDIATOR “Bantu beberapa persons membangun shared understanding.”

↓

AI DELEGATE “Lakukan communication terbatas dalam authority yang saya berikan.”

Tetapi semakin kita bergerak ke bawah:

semakin penting constraint, authority, ethics, dan accountability.

Model akhirnya:
[ ]
bukan:
[ AI Control Other Persons]
Prinsip paling penting Minggu 14 adalah:

Gunakan AI untuk membantu kita mengenali person dengan lebih baik, mendengar dengan lebih baik, menerjemahkan meaning dengan lebih baik, mengambil keputusan dengan lebih baik, dan berkomunikasi dengan lebih bertanggung jawab—bukan untuk menghindari menjadi manusia yang harus hadir, menilai, bertanggung jawab, dan membangun relationship.

Dengan demikian mahasiswa siap memasuki Minggu 15 — Capstone: The Complete Person-Centered Communicator, yang mengintegrasikan seluruh semester:

Self → Relationship → Professional Value → TAIDA → Negotiation → Community → Public Communication → AI-Mediated Communication

menjadi satu final communication performance.

Traditional communication model sering dimulai dari:

siapa yang hadir?
